testcase.system-out: Scenario: Retain the last selected template after an application restart ✔> Given a fresh MCAD Software session loads `fixtures/cad/document-creation-generic-candidate.opj` as its active project ✔> And its Metric folder contains a standard part template with the material label Generic ✔ Given fixture `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open with Sketch1 visible in the MCAD Software ✔ When the user presses Control+N ✔ Then the Create New File chooser opens over the part ✔ When the user selects the metric template folder ✔ And the user selects the standard metric part template in the Part group ✔ And the user cancels the chooser ✔ And the user closes the MCAD Software while the part remains unchanged ✔ And the user restarts the MCAD Software ✔ And the user opens fixture `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` ✔ And the user presses Control+N ✔ Then the Create New File chooser opens over the part ✔ And the template gallery is grouped by document type ✔ And Metric is selected in the template folder tree ✔ And the standard metric part template is selected in the Part group ✔ And the details identify a Part with millimeter units and Generic material ✔ And Create and Cancel are available ✔ And the existing part and sketch remain visible behind the chooser ✔ When the user presses Escape ✔ Then the chooser closes without creating a document ✔ And the same part and sketch remain active
